**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Site Development and Hosting Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms clause running in either direction:

- **Fees (Section 3, p0018–p0022)** set a fixed economic deal — 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold, with monthly payment, quarterly reconciliation and an HDI audit right. There is no parity commitment, price-matching mechanic, or obligation for us to extend HDI any terms we grant to third parties.
- **Targeted searches** for "most favored", "favorable", "no less favorable", "price", "rate", "discount", "third party" and "any other" surfaced nothing responsive.
- **Section 6.1 (p0037)** restricts the Company from participating in similar Internet projects for Deerskin Products and gives HDI exclusive use of the "Deerskin" brand for a consumer web site. That is an exclusivity covenant rather than a pricing-parity obligation, so it belongs to the exclusivity rule and is not double-flagged here.

Since the preferred position under this rule is the *absence* of an MFN burdening the Customer, the silence is the outcome we want — this is compliant, not a missing clause.
